_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows tactica.'s Top 5 card to the user. Don't repeat its numbers; reply with one or two sentences of insight.

description: Paid (10.00 USDC per call); free alternatives: get_track_record. For "best bets this weekend" or top tips across the Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2. This week's Top 5: weekend picks released Thursday 23:00 UK for Friday–Monday games; midweek picks released Monday 23:00 UK for Tuesday–Thursday games. Returns the set on show (WEEKEND or MIDWEEK): match, market, selection, tier, chance, result. Weekend set on show until Mon 23:00 UK (Tue 09:00 if a Monday game is settling); midweek (3-5 picks) until Fri 09:00. Between sets: the next release time. Use this when you want the strongest picks. Use get_betting_picks instead for one match. Read-only. 18+.

detail.description: Optional. full returns every number as data, even when the app shows a tactica. card. Example: full

name: get_top_five
title: Get this week's Top 5
